description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_PercentEncoder class, which handles percent-encoding operations for URIs, including encoding and normalization functions, along with preservation of specific characters.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_PercentEncoder
classes.description: A class that manages percent-encoding operations in URIs, providing methods for encoding strings and normalizing percent-encoding sequences.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the set of characters to preserve during encoding, allowing optional preservation of additional characters.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Replaces urlencode by encoding all non-reserved characters and any explicitly preserved characters.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Fixes URI percent-encoding by decoding unreserved characters and normalizing percent sequences, respecting the preserve set.
